reason: The agent took a booking for ten o'clock, but bookings are only accepted on the hour from 13:00 to 21:00, so it confirmed an impossible time.
name: Late-night booking

spec.goal: Book a table for two tonight for ten o'clock.
spec.behavior: You sound polite and concise. Give your name and booking details when asked, and confirm the details when they are read back. If they say the table is booked, thank them and end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Bookings are for today only, on the hour, from 13:00 to 21:00.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says they cannot book that time because it is outside the booking window.
